{{Quote|Can you give me your name?''"<br />"''Not my real name, but you may call me&hellip;Blink.''"<br />"''As in, "don't blink, or you'll be gone?"''"<br />"''Precisely.|Madhi Vaandt, and Blink|<ref name="Allies" />}}
'''Blink''' was the nickname of a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who served as a member of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxywide]] anti-[[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] organization [[Freedom Flight]]. In [[44 ABY]], he met with [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Madhi Vaandt]], who was running a segment for ''[[The Perre Needmo Newshour]]'' on existing slavery practices throughout the galaxy, on [[Vartos' moon|the moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vartos]]. There, he revealed that Freedom Flight was not behind the [[Liberation|recent revolt]] on [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]]. He then tipped Vaandt off to head to [[Blaudu Sextus]].
